title: Keto Udon Noodle Stir Fry
description: A keto twist on a classic Asian stir fry, using low-carb udon noodles and a variety of vegetables.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the French green beans and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the kissed cherry tomatoes and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the udon noodles and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, until heated through.
In a small bowl, whisk together the molten mozzarella cheese and soy sauce.
Pour the cheese sauce over the noodles and vegetables, and stir-fry for an additional minute.
Serve hot, garnished with additional kissed cherry tomatoes if desired.
Cook to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C) to ensure food safety.
